title: davallia scoparia
intro: Davallia scoparia, commonly known as the rabbal fern, is a type of plant that belongs to the Davalliaceae family. This plant is traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and aiding in the treatment of fever. The therapeutic actions of Davallia scoparia include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, making it effective in relieving coughs, colds, and flu symptoms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
